verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a developer-facing SaaS with official SDKs, but the evidence pack never documents any control for disabling vendor telemetry or usage tracking of the account holder or its SDKs. The per-server and per-email open/link tracking settings control tracking of email recipients, not the vendor's telemetry about the user. Configurable data retention is a separate privacy control and does not count as a telemetry opt-out.
